answer: One weekly AI vote on island wharf repairs requires 20 accepted inspection reviews. A dispatcher assigns fresh reports exclusively; auditors check defect citations against withheld survey results. Each report's discussion thread yields at most one receipt, bound to key and week. Reused or invalid receipts earn no credit; below 20, no vote. Thus n keys need 20n distinct accepted reviews, recurring work rather than reusable capital. This assumes honest auditors and a supply of fresh tasks; leaked answers or cheap shared models can weaken the work cost.
